name: Silver Stag
primary:
A silvery stag bursts out of your wand and gallops for 8 s without stopping. It hunts foes within 20 blocks, turning in smooth arcs from one to the next and ramming through them. Each foe it rams, at most once a second:
• Damage 2 ❤ arcane, 4 ❤ to the undead
• Thrown far aside
With no foes around it keeps running on. Allies it passes lose withering and blindness.
self_description: For 8 s the stag circles around you and charges any foe that comes within 12 blocks of you, then returns.
